title: Shadows, Day and Night
seo_title: Grade 5 Shadows and Day and Night Worksheets: Earth's Rotation and Shadow Data
standard_text: Represent data in graphical displays to reveal patterns of daily changes in length and direction of shadows, day and night, and the seasonal appearance of some stars in the night sky.
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 science worksheets on shadows, day and night (NGSS 5-ESS1-2): Earth's rotation, the sun's path from east to west, shadow length and direction, and graphs of shadow and daylight data. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Earth spins once a day, so the sun seems to move from east to west.
key_sub: Shadows point away from the sun: long in the morning and evening, shortest around midday.
body_html:
How to think about it

Earth spins on its axis once about every 24 hours. The half facing the sun has day; the other half has night. Because Earth spins toward the east, the sun appears to rise in the east, cross the sky and set in the west.

A shadow points away from the sun. In the morning and evening the sun is low, so shadows are long. Around midday the sun is highest, so shadows are shortest (in the United States they point north).

Example

A shadow is long and points west. Is it morning or evening?

The shadow points away from the sun.

So the sun is in the east.

Answer: morning

Example

Shadow lengths: 9 a.m. 120 cm, 12 p.m. 40 cm, 3 p.m. 110 cm. When was the sun highest?

Shortest shadow = highest sun.

Answer: 12 p.m.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the sun moves around Earth each day. Earth spins.
  • Thinking a shadow points toward the sun. It points away from it.
  • Thinking shadows are longest at noon. They are shortest then.
  • Thinking day and night happen everywhere at once.

faq.a: Earth spins on its axis about once every 24 hours. The side facing the sun has day, and the side facing away has night.

faq.q: Why do shadows change during the day?
faq.a: As Earth spins, the sun appears to move across the sky. A low sun makes long shadows; a high sun makes short ones. Shadows always point away from the sun.
Around midday, when the sun is highest in the sky.

faq.q: Which way do shadows point in the morning?
faq.a: Toward the west, because the sun is in the east.

items.q: When are shadows longest?
c: early morning and late afternoon, when the sun is low
items.e: A low sun makes long shadows.

items.q: What causes day and night?
c: clouds covering the sun at night
items.e: As Earth spins, your side faces the sun (day) and then faces away (night).

items.q: The sun is low in the western sky, as shown. Which way does the mailbox post's shadow point?
items.e: A shadow points away from the sun. The sun is in the west, so the shadow points east.

items.q: In the United States, which way does a shadow point at noon?
items.e: At noon the sun is in the southern part of the sky, so shadows point north.

items.q: When is your shadow shortest on a sunny day?
c: around midday, when the sun is highest
items.e: The higher the sun, the shorter the shadow.

items.q: The sun is partway up in the eastern sky, as shown. Which way does the lamp post's shadow point?

items.q: When it is daytime in the United States, it is nighttime in

items.e: Only the half of Earth facing the sun has day.
